title: Praxis with a scalar-only form field
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 7924 MiB (7.7376 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 26229 million field multiplications (19727 and 6503), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
